payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design with exaggerated minimalism. Use: oversized typography (clamp 3rem-12rem), extreme negative space, black/white primary, single accent color only, bold statements, minimal elements, dramatic contrast.
payload.best_for: Fashion, architecture, portfolios, agency landing pages, luxury brands, editorial
payload.css_technical_keywords: font-size: clamp(3rem, 10vw, 12rem), font-weight: 900, letter-spacing: -0.05em, color: #000 or #FFF, padding: 8rem+, single accent, no decorations
payload.do_not_use_for: E-commerce catalogs, dashboards, forms, data-heavy, elderly users, complex apps
payload.effects_and_animation: font-size: clamp(3rem 10vw 12rem), font-weight: 900, letter-spacing: -0.05em, massive whitespace
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Typography oversized, ☐ White space extreme, ☐ Black/white dominant, ☐ Single accent only, ☐ Elements minimal, ☐ Statement clear
payload.keywords: Bold minimalism, oversized typography, high contrast, negative space, loud minimal, statement design
payload.secondary_colors: Minimal - single accent color, no secondary colors, extreme restraint
